changelog: **Settings and the skill vocabulary fit a phone again (e2e-full red on `main`):** the stage-SLA rows gained a third number input (#1722) that squeezed the stage name to 50px at 360px — below `sm` the name now takes its own line and the inputs wrap under it (`w-20`, right-aligned under their column headings, since "Eskalieren nach" did not fit `w-16`); the mail tabs gained a third tab (#1692) that pushed the super admin's mail card 35px past the screen — the tab strip now wraps; and `/admin/skills`' toolbar (#1817) used fixed-width fields — they are full-width below `sm`. `e2e/mobile-layout-coverage.spec.ts` now also audits `/admin/attributes`, `/admin/agreements`, `/admin/reports`, `/admin/billing` and `/admin/sla`, which were added to the sidebar without an entry.

en: Settings and the skill list no longer run off the edge of a phone screen.
tr: Ayarlar ve beceri listesi artık telefon ekranından taşmıyor.
de: Einstellungen und die Skill-Liste laufen auf dem Handy nicht mehr über den Bildschirmrand.
